templates.name: 6. 漏光转场
templates.description: 动效转场：漏光转场 / Light Leak — a warm film light leak blooms across the frame in orange and magenta, overexposing the outgoing scene until it dissolves into the incoming scene
templates.description_en: Light Leak - a warm film light leak blooms across the frame in orange and magenta, overexposing the outgoing scene until it dissolves into the incoming scene
templates.prompt:
A seamless Light Leak transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] A warm film light leak blooms across the frame in orange and magenta, overexposing the outgoing scene until it dissolves into the incoming scene. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: analog film hiss with a warm glowing bloom, camera shutter click. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a nostalgic lo-fi synth melody, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
